title: Benchmark result
description: artifacts/bench/<id>/<variant>.json, written canonically by polypiler-tooling bench run. Times are integer nanoseconds, sizes integer bytes.

median.description: The middle sample; for an even count the mean of the two middle ones, rounded half to even.

mad.description: The median absolute deviation from the median; no sample is removed as an outlier.

environment.description: Results are compared only when their fingerprints agree (PLY0072).

toolchains.description: The version of each toolchain used, by its key in tooling/toolchains.lock.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the object without this property.

samples.description: One entry per measured run (process) or measured iteration (dotnet); warm-up runs are excluded.

wallNs.description: Execution time: wall clock; for dotnet the time of one operation.

cpuNs.description: Execution time: user and system processor time of the run's process tree.

peakRssBytes.description: Peak memory: the largest resident memory of the run's process tree.

buildNs.description: Build time: the median time of the build steps.

sourceBytes.description: Generated source size: the bytes of sizes.source.

binaryBytes.description: Binary size: the bytes of sizes.binary after the build.

allocatedBytes.description: Compilation cost: the bytes the compiler allocates per operation, measured in process by BenchmarkDotNet (dotnet only).

allocations.description: Allocation count per operation, where the measurement provides it (dotnet only).

extra.description: Further named metrics the caller supplied, compared like any other.
